understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to activate and complete all goal cells in each level. A goal cell only completes when the carried piece matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the same time, and you then step onto the goal. Completing all goals advances to the next level; finishing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a movement action (north/south/east/west). Movement can be blocked by walls, leaving you in place. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece’s attributes: shape modifiers cycle shape, color modifiers cycle color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. The game tracks whether each goal is currently matched and may point to relevant modifier tile locations needed to fix mismatches (e.g., using rotation_changer tiles to adjust rotation). Each action consumes stamina; if stamina reaches zero you lose a life and stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game.
